title: The vertical slice
about: Room creation to operational read model: every step persisted and authorized on the server.
mermaid:
%% The production vertical slice. Every arrow into the API is authenticated; every write is one transaction with an audit row and an outbox event.
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor D as Designer
  actor S as Systems engineer
  actor C as Commissioning engineer
  actor Q as QA reviewer
  participant API as enterprise-api
  participant DB as PostgreSQL
  participant OS as Object storage
  participant W as Outbox worker
  D->>API: POST /v1/rooms (template, dimensions)
  API->>DB: room + revision 1 + classification (server-side engine) + audit + outbox
  D->>API: POST /v1/rooms/{id}/devices
  API->>DB: planned asset (unique per tenant) + CONTAINS / CONNECTS edges
  D->>API: POST /v1/rooms/{id}/revisions
  API->>DB: immutable revision snapshot + drawing revisions (input hash)
  S->>API: POST /v1/rooms/{id}/commissioning-plan
  API->>DB: 94 definitions judged, rows persisted (never PASS)
  API->>DB: design checks → issues (correlation key, unique)
  S->>API: lifecycle transitions (authority checked server-side)
  C->>API: POST /v1/evidence (bytes)
  API->>OS: put (content-addressed, sha256)
  C->>API: POST /v1/rooms/{id}/results (FAIL → deficiency → work order)
  C->>API: POST /v1/rooms/{id}/results (PASS → PASS_UNVERIFIED)
  Q->>API: POST /v1/rooms/{id}/results/{test}/verify (a different person)
  W->>DB: outbox → operational read model, notifications
  Q->>API: GET /v1/read/rooms/{id}

title: Event delivery
about: Transactional outbox with retries, idempotent consumers and a dead letter.
mermaid:
%% Event delivery: transactional outbox, at-least-once delivery, idempotent consumers, dead letter after the retry budget. flowchart LR TX[API transaction
state change + audit row + outbox row] --> OB[(outbox_event
status PENDING)] OB --> W{worker
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED} W -->|handler ok| DONE[(DELIVERED)] W -->|error, attempts < 8| RETRY[(PENDING, next_attempt_at = backoff)] RETRY --> W W -->|attempts exhausted| DLQ[(DEAD_LETTER
visible to admins)] W --> RM[room_read_model] W --> NT[notification]

title: Who receives what
about: The source vault, the founder studio, the engineering workspace and the investor and engineer packages, kept apart.
mermaid:
%% Separation of what goes to whom. The source vault never enters an investor package. flowchart LR VAULT[(Founder source vault
RESTRICTED_IP)] --> PROD[Production Engineering Workspace
editable source, DB, API, tests] VAULT --> FOUNDER[Founder Studio
founder only, local] PROD -- build + gates + verify --> INVPKG[Investor Edition package
no source, no engineering controls] PROD -- build + gates --> ENGPKG[Private Engineer Edition
authorized reviewers only] INVPKG -. distribution needs owner written approval .-> INVESTORS((Investors)) ENGPKG -. under NDA .-> REVIEWERS((Technical reviewers))
